title: Battery drains quickly on a Galaxy phone or tablet
content:
Smartphone,Tablet Battery drains quickly on a Galaxy phone or tablet: ## Troubleshooting Rapid Battery Drain
If your device is losing charge faster than expected, work through the following checks.
### Step 1: Review Battery Usage
Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap Battery.
Review which apps have consumed the most power since the last full charge.
### Step 2: Limit Background Activity
Go to Settings, tap Battery, and then tap Background usage limits.
Add rarely used apps to the list so they cannot run in the background.
### Step 3: Enable Power Saving
Go to Settings, tap Battery, and then tap the switch next to Power saving.
Power saving reduces processor speed and background network usage.
### Step 4: Protect the Battery
Go to Settings, tap Battery, and then tap Battery protection to cap the maximum charge level.
### Step 5: Inspect the Charger and Cable
Examine the USB cable and adapter for damage or corrosion.
Try using a different, undamaged charger to rule out a faulty power source.
### Step 6: Restart the Device
Press and hold the Power button and the Volume down button at the same time.
Tap Restart again to confirm.
### Step 7: Factory Data Reset
Back up your data before proceeding with this step.
Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap General management.
Tap Reset.
Tap Factory data reset.
Tap Delete all.
